info.title: API.SH: Property Finder
info.description: The Property Finder API from API.SH: public Property Finder data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Property Finder's agency (broker) directory, 20 a page: each agency's id, name, slug, address, city, phone, email, licence, verified flag, listing counts, agents and super agents, transactions, description, logo and link. Filter by area (name or id) and service; sort by featured or most listings. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propertyfinder-agencies

get.description:
Property listings on Property Finder (UAE) to buy or rent, residential or commercial, or new projects, with location, property type, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, area, furnishing, amenities, keywords, rent period, listed-within and verified filters and the site's sorts. Each listing: id, reference, title, type, price, currency and period, price per area, bedrooms, bathrooms, size, furnishing, completion status, location (with path and position), amenities, description, listed date, badges (verified, featured, exclusive, great value, price drop), photos, agent, agency, permit details and link. 25 per page; `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propertyfinder-search

parameters.name: rent_period

get.summary: Property Finder sold and rented transactions (Dubai)
get.description:
Registered Dubai property sales and rental contracts as Property Finder shows them (Dubai Land Department records), 10 per page up to 50 pages: date, price, price per sqft, bedrooms, property type, off-plan or ready, unit number, area, building and community, and for rentals the contract start and end dates. Also returns the market insights for the location (average sale price and price per sqft with their yearly change, average new and renewed rents, ROI, transaction volume) and its sub-areas with their transaction counts (pass a sub-area's `location` back to drill down). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propertyfinder-transactions

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location path: dubai (default), a community or building under it (dubai/dubai-marina, as `sub_locations[].location` gives), or a property type page (dubai/villas, dubai/2-bedroom-apartments).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A propertyfinder.ae transactions page (https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/transactions/sold/dubai/...), instead of location and type.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: sold (default) or rented.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, price_desc, price_asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-50). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
